blocks.text: Graph ki kuch aur details (tafseel) bhi hain jo us ki banawat batati hain:

items: Degree: kisi vertex se judi edges ki ginti. Maslan agar ek shehar teen shehron se jura ho to us vertex ki degree 3 hai.
Weight (wazan): kuch graphs mein edges par values hoti hain, jaise faasla ya kharcha (cost). Maslan do shehron ke beech sarak 50 kilometre lambi ho to us edge ka weight 50 ho sakta hai.

Direction (simt): edges directed ya undirected hoti hain. Directed edge ek taraf ka connection hai: shehar A se B ki sarak ho to zaroori nahi ke B se A wapsi ki sarak bhi ho. Undirected edge dono taraf ka connection hai.

blocks.text: Yeh program Figure 4.12 ki edges se har vertex ki degree ginta hai. edges mein nayi edge jorein, maslan "A-C", aur Run kar ke dekhein ke degrees aur un ka total kaise badalte hain.

edges = ["A-B", "A-E", "B-E", "B-D", "B-C", "C-D", "E-D"]   # Figure 4.12

degree = dict()
for edge in edges:
    u, v = edge.split("-")
    degree[u] = degree.get(u, 0) + 1      # an undirected edge counts at both ends
    degree[v] = degree.get(v, 0) + 1
for vertex in sorted(degree):
    print("Degree of", vertex, "=", degree[vertex])
print("Total of degrees:", sum(degree.values()), "= 2 x", len(edges), "edges")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"edges = [...]": Figure 4.12 ki 7 edges, har ek "A-B" jaisi string.
"degree = dict()": har vertex ki degree (us se judi edges ki ginti) rakhne ke liye khali dictionary.
"for edge in edges: u, v = edge.split("-")": "A-B" ko "-" par tor kar u = "A" aur v = "B".
"degree[u] = degree.get(u, 0) + 1" (aur v ke liye bhi): undirected (bina teer wali) edge dono siron ko ginti mein 1 deti hai. .get(u, 0) pehli baar 0 deta hai.
"for vertex in sorted(degree):": vertices alphabet ki tarteeb mein (A, B, C, D, E) chhapne ke liye.
Aakhri print: saari degrees ka jor aur edges ka double dikhata hai; yeh hamesha barabar hote hain kyun ke har edge do baar ginti hoti hai.
Output: "Degree of A = 2", "Degree of B = 4", "Degree of C = 2", "Degree of D = 3", "Degree of E = 3", phir "Total of degrees: 14 = 2 x 7 edges".
Khud try karein: edges mein "A-C" jor kar Run karein: A aur C ki degree 3 ho jayegi aur "Total of degrees: 16 = 2 x 8 edges" aayega.

blocks.prompt: Undirected graph jis ki edges A-B, A-E, B-E, B-D, B-C, C-D aur E-D hain (Figure 4.12), us mein har vertex ki degree kya hai?
blocks.explanation: A 2, B 4, C 2, D 3, E 3. Degrees ka total (jama) 14 hai, jo 7 edges ka dugna hai.
